1: // Minimalist Gravity Flip game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   const BALL_RADIUS = 10;
12:   const GRAVITY = 0.3; // acceleration per frame
13:   const PLATFORM_LENGTH = Math.min(width, height) * 0.8;
14:   const PLATFORM_SPEED = 0.01; // radians per frame
15: 
16:   let gravityDir = 1; // 1 = down, -1 = up
17:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => (gravityDir *= -1));
18: 
19:   const ball = {
20:     x: width / 2,
21:     y: height / 2,
22:     vx: 0,
23:     vy: 0,
24:     radius: BALL_RADIUS,
25:     update() {
26:       // apply gravity
27:       this.vy += GRAVITY * gravityDir;
28:       this.x += this.vx;
29:       this.y += this.vy;
30:     },
31:     draw() {
32:       ctx.beginPath();
33:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
34:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5722';
35:       ctx.fill();
36:     }
37:   };
38: 
39:   const platform = {
40:     angle: 0,
41:     update() {
42:       this.angle += PLATFORM_SPEED;
43:     },
44:     // return end points of the rotating line (centered)
45:     getPoints() {
46:       const cx = width / 2;
47:       const cy = height / 2;
48:       const half = PLATFORM_LENGTH / 2;
49:       const cos = Math.cos(this.angle);
50:       const sin = Math.sin(this.angle);
51:       const x1 = cx - half * cos;
52:       const y1 = cy - half * sin;
53:       const x2 = cx + half * cos;
54:       const y2 = cy + half * sin;
55:       return { x1, y1, x2, y2 };
56:     },
57:     draw() {
58:       const { x1, y1, x2, y2 } = this.getPoints();
59:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#3f51b5';
60:       ctx.lineWidth = 8;
61:       ctx.beginPath();
62:       ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
63:       ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
64:       ctx.stroke();
65:     }
66:   };
67: 
68:   // Helper: distance from point to line segment
69:   function pointLineDist(px, py, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
70:     const A = px - x1;
71:     const B = py - y1;
72:     const C = x2 - x1;
73:     const D = y2 - y1;
74:     const dot = A * C + B * D;
75:     const lenSq = C * C + D * D;
76:     let param = -1;
77:     if (lenSq !== 0) param = dot / lenSq;
78:     let xx, yy;
79:     if (param < 0) {
80:       xx = x1; yy = y1;
81:     } else if (param > 1) {
82:       xx = x2; yy = y2;
83:     } else {
84:       xx = x1 + param * C;
85:       yy = y1 + param * D;
86:     }
87:     const dx = px - xx;
88:     const dy = py - yy;
89:     return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
90:   }
91: 
92:   // Collision handling – simple stick to platform when nearing from gravity direction
93:   function handleCollision() {
94:     const { x1, y1, x2, y2 } = platform.getPoints();
95:     const dist = pointLineDist(ball.x, ball.y, x1, y1, x2, y2);
96:     if (dist < ball.radius) {
97:       // Determine which side of the line the ball is on
98:       const side = (ball.x - x1) * (y2 - y1) - (ball.y - y1) * (x2 - x1);
99:       // side > 0 means one side, <0 the opposite
100:       const shouldStick = (gravityDir === 1 && side > 0) || (gravityDir === -1 && side < 0);
101:       if (shouldStick) {
102:         // Project ball onto line to keep it on surface
103:         const t = ((ball.x - x1) * (x2 - x1) + (ball.y - y1) * (y2 - y1)) / ((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2);
104:         const projX = x1 + t * (x2 - x1);
105:         const projY = y1 + t * (y2 - y1);
106:         // Move ball to surface
107:         const normal = Math.sqrt((ball.x - projX) ** 2 + (ball.y - projY) ** 2);
108:         const moveFactor = (ball.radius - normal) / normal;
109:         ball.x = ball.x + (ball.x - projX) * moveFactor;
110:         ball.y = ball.y + (ball.y - projY) * moveFactor;
111:         // Cancel velocity perpendicular to platform
112:         const vx = ball.vx;
113:         const vy = ball.vy;
114:         const nx = -(y2 - y1);
115:         const ny = x2 - x1;
116:         const len = Math.hypot(nx, ny);
117:         const nxu = nx / len;
118:         const nyu = ny / len;
119:         const perp = vx * nxu + vy * nyu;
120:         ball.vx = vx - perp * nxu;
121:         ball.vy = vy - perp * nyu;
122:         // Add small friction along platform
123:         ball.vx *= 0.99;
124:         ball.vy *= 0.99;
125:       }
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function loseCheck() {
130:     if (ball.y - ball.radius > height || ball.y + ball.radius < 0) {
131:       // Reset game state
132:       ball.x = width / 2;
133:       ball.y = height / 2;
134:       ball.vx = 0;
135:       ball.vy = 0;
136:       gravityDir = 1;
137:     }
138:   }
139: 
140:   function loop() {
141:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
142:     platform.update();
143:     platform.draw();
144:     ball.update();
145:     handleCollision();
146:     ball.draw();
147:     loseCheck();
148:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149:   }
150: 
151:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
152: })();

(End of file - total 152 lines)
